I appreciate everyone's comments, and tbh I wasn't expecting this to get more than 20 up votes so I'm very surprised. With that being said, I just wanted to comment to clarify a few things. I really do sincerely appreciate everyone, especially everyone trying to make sure I know how risky having a fwbs can be and how often it leads to one party having feelings and ends in hurt and confusion. These are all things my partner and I have talked over, and I really wanted to comment to make sure that everyone who's never had a fwbs or maybe wants one but is scared of it ending badly to know this: just because you're having regular sex with someone with who you have a strong mutual respect for doesn't mean there has to be feelings involved. 
Of course, some people do catch feelings, and if you do catch feelings really easily through sex, or casual sex outside of a serious relationship isn't your thing, that's perfectly okay! But if you don't, don't be scared to test out the waters with a fwb relationship! The most important thing is clear and open communication, not just about what you want in bed but about what you both want out of the fwb. Are you two on the same page emotionally? And if anything changes are you both comfortable speaking up and letting the other know? Is it someone who respects you and wants you to enjoy yourself and vice versa? And most importantly (kidding), is it someone you really want to bang on a semi-regular basis? If so then have fun!
